detail.longDescription: 8 apps already on your Mac that you've probably never opened. New on Medium 🧰 There's a folder on every Mac that most people open once, by accident, and close again: Utilities. My AI agent read the app bundles one by one, without launching a single app, and checked each feature against Apple's own guides. Grapher draws equations in 3D and ships 18 example documents. Digital Color Meter shows the color under the cursor, live. ColorSync Utility is where the filter behind Preview's Reduce File Size lives. Audio MIDI Setup plays audio on several outputs at once. Then Screen Sharing, Archive Utility, System Information and Script Editor, plus two newer ones Apple added quietly. One command opens each: open -a "Digital Color Meter" Which one did you already know? And which one did I miss? https:// medium.com/@giovambattista.faz ioli/8-apps-already-on-your-mac-that-youve-probably-never-opened-6048f7bf28b5 # macOS # Mac # Apple # Productivity # MacTips
